items.title: S&P Global (SPGI) Stock Trades At A Premium To Its Earnings Power
items.summary: S&P Global has delivered a 29.2% gain over the past three years. With the shares recently around US$471, the real question is whether that price is supported by the returns the business earns on its capital. Recent news around index partnerships and data services has refreshed the story, but the valuation hinge is still the efficiency with which S&P Global turns invested funds into profits. items.title: S&P revises GM outlook to positive on widening margins and cash flow
items.summary: Investing.com -- S&P Global Ratings has revised its credit outlook on General Motors Company (NYSE:GM) and subsidiary General Motors Financial Co. Inc. to positive from stable, citing significant margin recovery and expanding cash generation. S&P affirmed its 'BBB' issuer credit ratings on both entities, pointing to a potential upgrade over the next 12 to 24 months.
